scoring_justification: Cannot re-run DFT in verifier; verify energy ordering and angle ranges from the reported CSV.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold angle ranges and ordering check to verify the computed results follow the expected physical trend.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 4: PBE-D3 bent angle ~130.7°, linear ~179.7°; PBE ordering linear more stable than bent; PBE-D3 ordering bent more stable than linear.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's Table 4 and used as structural constraints.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are from the published paper; used only to set acceptable angle ranges and ordering expectations.

outputs.description: Computed results from periodic DFT optimizations, including energy ordering between bent and linear polymorphs with and without dispersion correction.

output_contract.notes: The ordering of relative energies (which structure is more stable) and the numerical ranges of the P-C-P angles are the scored quantities. The checker will verify that the reported values follow the physically meaningful trend and lie within acceptable tolerances derived from the paper's reference data.

checks.description: PBE: Cprime_linear must have lower total energy per molecule than A_bent (linear more stable).
PBE-D3: A_bent must have lower total energy per molecule than Cprime_linear (bent more stable).
A_bent PCP angle in [125, 145] degrees for both PBE and PBE-D3 rows.
Cprime_linear PCP angle in [170, 180] degrees for both PBE and PBE-D3 rows.
